sections.label: SFA consolidates food safety oversight
sections.summary: The SFA will consolidate regulatory oversight of food safety and security aspects in a single public sector agency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The SFA will consolidate regulatory oversight for these different aspects of food safety and security in a single public sector agency.

sections.label: Singapore tops Global Food Security Index
sections.summary: The 2018 Global Food Security Index ranks Singapore first in ensuring citizens have access to safe, nutritious, affordable food.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The 2018 Global Food Security Index puts Singapore as the No 1 country in the world in ensuring that citizens have access to safe and nutritious food at affordable prices.

sections.label: Global population growth by 2050
sections.summary: By 2050, the global population is expected to grow another 30% to 9.7 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: By 2050, the global population is expected to grow another 30% to 9.7 billion.

sections.label: Rice production fall and food imports
sections.summary: Rice production can fall by more than 50%, threatening Singapore, which imports more than 90% of its food.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Rice production can fall by more than 50%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These are real-life threats and can hit us badly since we import more than 90% of our food.

sections.label: Consolidating NEA, AVA, HSA capabilities
sections.summary: NEA and AVA licensing, compliance, investigation and HSA testing capabilities will consolidate in SFA to respond to food safety incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: It is in our DNA to constantly look ahead, anticipate trends, adapt and seize opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will consolidate NEA and AVA’s current capabilities in licensing, compliance management, investigation and testing by HSA, in SFA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: SFA will be able to holistically respond to food safety incidents wherever these occur along the food supply chain.

sections.label: SFA partners businesses to transform industry
sections.summary: Besides regulatory oversight of the food industry, SFA will partner businesses to transform Singapore's food industry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In addition to regulatory oversight of the food industry, SFA will partner businesses to transform our food industry.

sections.label: SFA as body corporate
sections.summary: Part 2 of the Bill establishes SFA as a body corporate with a structure similar to major Statutory Boards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Part 2 of the Bill establishes SFA as a body corporate with a structure similar to major Statutory Boards.

sections.label: Transfer of food-regulatory undertakings
sections.summary: Part 8 transfers relevant food-regulatory undertakings, including assets, liabilities and employees, from AVA, NEA and HSA to SFA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Part 8 contains the provisions that transfer the relevant food-regulatory undertakings, including assets, liabilities and employees, from AVA, NEA and HSA to SFA.

sections.label: Repeal of Cattle Act
sections.summary: Clause 56 repeals the Cattle Act as obsolete, with similar powers provided under the Animals and Birds Act, Sale of Food Act and EPHA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clause 56 repeals the Cattle Act as that becomes obsolete, with similar powers provided for under the Animals and Birds Act, Sale of Food Act, and Environmental Public Health Act (EPHA).

sections.label: Malaysia egg and seafood exports
sections.summary: Last December, Malaysia announced it was considering limiting or stopping egg exports and restricting exports of certain seafood types.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Members will recall that only last December, Malaysia had announced that it was considering limiting or stopping egg exports and restricting exports of certain types of seafood.

sections.label: Strengthening Singapore food security
sections.summary: With SFA's formation, Singapore will continue to strengthen food security and reduce vulnerability to external volatility and price hikes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: With the formation of SFA, we will continue to strengthen Singapore's food security and reduce our vulnerability to external volatility and price hikes.

sections.label: Trademark regulations for food
sections.summary: Clause 64 amends the Sale of Food Act to enable regulations prescribing when trademarks may or may not be used for food or advertising.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clause 64 makes a related amendment to the Sale of Food Act to enable regulations to prescribe the circumstances when trademarks may or may not be used in relation to any particular food or its advertising.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This will support existing work by the Formula Milk Taskforce led by Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon, in particular, to ensure that labelling and the provision of information are done in a manner that protects consumer interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Part 10 of the Bill provides for saving and transitional arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These will cover AVA's financial statements for financial year 2018, and appeals made before the commencement of SFA and pending when the amendments take effect.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As the lead agency for food-related matters, SFA will be well-placed to work closely with all stakeholders from farm-to-fork to transform the agri-food industry, seize opportunities in the future food landscape and provide good jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: With large-scale food poisoning cases, including one fatal case and with undesirable foreign items discovered in prepacked food, Singaporeans cannot help but wonder if our eateries and relevant Government agencies are getting things right in food hygiene management.

sections.label: Food safety risks management
sections.summary: These developments would raise the probability of food safety lapses, so the Government needs to better manage food safety risks.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In short, all these developments would lead to a higher probability in food safety lapses, and so there is a need for the Government to better manage food safety risks.

sections.label: SFA diversification requirements powers
sections.summary: Under the Bill, SFA will get powers to impose diversification requirements on food importers through licensing conditions.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: With the new powers that SFA will get through this Bill, they will be able to impose diversification requirements on food importers via licensing conditions.

sections.label: Local food supply resilience
sections.summary: SFA intends to work with industry and R&D partners to develop products and solutions enhancing food supply resilience despite land, energy and water constraints.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Creating our own supply of food is another vital aspect of food security.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am heartened to note that SFA intends to work with the industry and research and development (R&D) partners to develop new products and solutions that can enhance food supply resilience, while overcoming resource constraints in land, energy and water.

sections.label: Timeliness of setting up SFA
sections.summary: Given recent food poisoning cases and a neighbouring country's planned food supply restriction, SFA must review the industry and develop urban farming.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):  : Recently, there were a number of food poisoning cases.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Our neighbouring country also said they were going to restrict food supply.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Setting up SFA now cannot be more timely.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: SFA must thoroughly review the whole industry and see how to improve our food safety and the supply chain.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am glad that SFA will endeavour to overcome our geographical limitation and develop urban farming, making Singapore a global leader in this area.

sections.label: SFA subsumes food-related functions
sections.summary: The new SFA will subsume the food-related functions of AVA, NEA and HSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The new SFA will subsume the food-related functions of AVA, NEA and HSA.

sections.label: WHO on unsafe food
sections.summary: The World Health Organization said unsafe food is a global threat, contributing to over 300,000 deaths in 2010 alone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The World Health Organization has said that unsafe food is a global threat, contributing to over 300,000 deaths in 2010 alone, for example.

sections.label: Nutrition labelling and sugar declaration
sections.summary: 26 countries make nutrition labelling mandatory while Singapore has a voluntary regime, and SFA is asked to consider compulsory total and added sugar declaration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: According to the European Union’s (EU's) Global Nutrition Update 2018, 26 countries, including in our neighbourhood – Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea – plus all the member states of the EU and all the member states of the Gulf Co-operation Council, now make nutrition labelling mandatory, while 13 countries have a voluntary labelling regime of which Singapore is currently one.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Allergens, such as nuts, should be clearly called out on food labels, given the rise in diagnosis of allergies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Also, would SFA consider making it compulsory for food importers to declare on the label the quantity of total and added sugar, as is now the case in the US?

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund disbursement rate
sections.summary: Over $13 million has been awarded to 74 farms from the $63 million APF, but only over $7 million has been disbursed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The rate of disbursement of the $63 million Agriculture Productivity Fund (APF), launched in 2014, appears to be low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: As per the answer to my Parliamentary Question in July 2018, over $13 million has been awarded to 74 farms from APF to date, of which only over $7 million has been disbursed.

sections.label: Big F&B companies sales growth
sections.summary: The 25 biggest F&B companies generated 45% of sales in America but drove only 3% of total sales growth between 2011 and 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: As reported in The Economist, the 25 biggest F&B companies generated 45% of sales in America but drove only 3% of the total growth in sales between 2011 and 2015.

sections.label: Nurturing food industry companies
sections.summary: It is asked whether SFA or organisations like SPRING and EDB will handle the business of nurturing food industry companies such as food micro-brands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Will the business of nurturing food industry companies, such as food micro-brands, be handled by SFA or will it still be driven by organisations like the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board and the Economic Development Board (EDB)?

sections.label: Deploying emerging technologies like blockchain
sections.summary: Clarity is sought on whether the Ministry has explored deploying emerging technologies such as blockchain to tackle such challenges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To tackle such challenges, can I seek clarity if the Ministry has explored deploying emerging technologies, such as blockchain?

sections.label: Food safety checks for online purchases
sections.summary: The Minister is asked to clarify how food products bought online are checked for food safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Can the Minister clarify how such food products that are bought online are checked for food safety?

sections.label: Imported food price increase
sections.summary: Singapore, as a price taker, was directly affected by global food trends, with imported food prices rising 7.8% between December 2007 and December 2008.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As a price taker, we are directly affected by the global food trends resulting in a 7.8% increase in prices of imported food between December 2007 and December 2008.

sections.label: Loan financing for innovation schemes
sections.summary: Firms appreciated schemes like APF for innovation or technological improvements, but securing loan financing from banks was still cited as an issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While they are appreciative of schemes, such as APF, that enable them to undertake innovation or technological improvements, securing loan financing from banks was still cited as an issue.

sections.label: Halal food accreditation and market
sections.summary: MUIS announced Singapore halal food products are recognised by international standards, and the member asked if SFA plans to work with MUIS and economic agencies on global halal demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On the topic of food industry development, I note that the Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS) recently announced that halal food products from Singapore are now recognised by international standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This represents an important opportunity for Singapore to capitalise on the growing global halal market by increasing international usage of its recognised standards of halal food accreditation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Thus, I would like to ask if SFA plans to work with MUIS and relevant economic agencies to ride on this growing demand for halal products and services globally and to capture the market for Singapore.

sections.label: Expanding sector for food security
sections.summary: Expanding this sector enhances food security and develops a new growth industry that can create jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: By expanding this sector, we not only enhance our food security, but we also develop a new growth industry that can create jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Food manufacturing GDP and agency coordination
sections.summary: Food manufacturing contributed $4.3 billion to GDP in 2017, and the member asked about coordination among NEA, AVA and HSA under SFA and a consolidated contact point.

sentences.speaker: Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: The food manufacturing industry in Singapore contributed $4.3 billion towards our gross domestic product in 2017 alone – not a small sum.

sentences.speaker: Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: As such, my first query is on the coordination between the roles and responsibilities of NEA, AVA and HSA, and how this is going to come under the SFA umbrella and perhaps also some simple and consolidated point of contact for consumers and the public as well.

sections.label: National Centre for Food Science update
sections.summary: The member asked the Minister to update on the National Centre for Food Science.

sentences.speaker: Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: Can the Minister also update us on the National Centre for Food Science?

sections.label: Healthier Ingredient Development programme update
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Minister for an update on the Healthier Ingredient Development programme.

sentences.speaker: Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: One other query I have is for an update by the Minister on the Healthier Ingredient Development programme.

sections.label: Singapore food security and safety
sections.summary: Singapore depends on imports for food, and topped the Global Food Security Index last year for the first time.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: As a small nation and city-state highly dependent on imports for our food supply, food security and safety are a constant concern for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We have done well in this respect, having topped the Global Food Security Index last year for the first time.

sections.label: Food price rises over decades
sections.summary: The Consumer Price Index shows food prices excluding food services rose 22% from 2009 to 2018 and 51% from 1999 to 2019.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: According to the Consumer Price Index, the price of food, excluding food services, rose 22% in the last 10 years from 2009 to 2018, and 51% in the last 20 years from 1999 to 2019.

sections.label: Food share of poorest households
sections.summary: The 2012/2013 Household Expenditure Survey shows food expenses are about 13% of total expenditure for the bottom 20% of households.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Household Expenditure Survey of 2012/2013 shows that for the bottom 20% of households, in terms of income, food expenses make up some 13% of total expenditure.

sections.label: Egg price rise from import sources
sections.summary: The Minister for Trade and Industry said egg prices from some import sources rose up to 50% between June and November 2018.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Last month, I asked the Minister for Trade and Industry about the rise in prices of eggs, which is a staple in our food culture and an important source of nutrition for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: He said that the prices of eggs from some of our import sources went up significantly between June and November 2018, by up to 50%.

sections.label: Lien Centre food insecurity findings
sections.summary: Lien Centre researchers found about two-fifths of surveyed households had mild food insecurity, one-third moderate and one-fifth severe.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Lien Centre for Social Innovation researchers found that around two-fifths of the households surveyed experienced mild food insecurity, meaning that they worried about the ability to obtain food, while one-third experienced moderate insecurity, having to compromise on quality and variety of food.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Around one-fifth experienced severe insecurity, cutting down on quantity consumed and experiencing actual hunger.

sections.label: National food support system need
sections.summary: Researchers concluded a national food support system is needed to combat household food insecurity.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The researchers concluded that there is a need to focus on developing a national food support system to combat household food insecurity.

sections.label: Clause 64 record-keeping requirements
sections.summary: Clause 64 amends the Sale of Food Act to expand record-keeping for data on food supply.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Just to give an example of how the powers of the Agency will be useful in this respect, clause 64 of the Bill amends section 56(1) of the Sale of Food Act, expanding the record-keeping requirements to enable the collection of current and accurate data related to secure and reliable food supply, such as data about the level of imports or stores of food held by food businesses.

sections.label: Food available versus wasted 2016
sections.summary: 2016 figures show more than half of food available in Singapore was wasted.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Based on 2016 figures provided by AVA, there were almost 1.4 million tonnes of food, plus 1.9 million eggs, available for consumption versus almost 800,000 tonnes of food wasted in the same period, according to NEA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This shows that more than half of all food available in Singapore was wasted in 2016.

sections.label: Household avoidable food waste
sections.summary: A 2017 NEA study found households generate 168,000 tonnes of food waste, about 21% of total.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Let us now examine the amount of "avoidable" food waste generated by each household, Mr Speaker.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This amounts to 2.5 kilogrammes (kg) each week, according to a 2017 study by the NEA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: With 1.28 million households in Singapore, 168,000 tonnes of food waste are generated by households, which is about 21% of total food waste of the 800,000 tonnes I mentioned earlier.

sections.label: Tax rebate based on weight
sections.summary: The tax rebate should be based on weight of food donated, not price.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The tax rebate should also be based on weight of food donated, not price.

sections.label: Food issues reporting and whistleblowing
sections.summary: A suggestion was made for a more robust food issues reporting and whistleblowing system under clause 5(1)(e).

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: With this in mind, I would like to make further suggestions specific to the Bill including: (a) a more robust and accessible food issues reporting and whistleblowing system in performing its functions of regulating businesses, as per clause 5(1)(e).

sections.label: Food labelling, analytics, carbon pricing
sections.summary: Calls for balancing information labelling with non-commercial composting, deeper food source analytics, and carbon pricing rewards for reducing food system carbon.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While championing the development of information labelling systems, as per clause 5(1)(h), there is also a need to strike a balance to ensure it does not become a barrier, for example, to the use of non-commercial composting as fertiliser within our food systems.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It would be counterproductive to stifle production systems and models that are striving to achieve wholesome nutritious food that is also fair to producers; (c) developing deeper analytics as part of data collection in clause 5(1)(n) around our food sources and nutritional content over a period of time to ensure wholesomeness of our food supply is not compromised due to changing geographical and climate realities affecting our food sources; and (d) exploring ways within or related to our carbon pricing framework to reward actors that are helping to reduce the carbon burden of our food system.

sections.label: No food goes to waste
sections.summary: States that actions on food shall follow the spirit of saving every grain, with no food going to waste.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Whatever actions we take with food, it shall be with the same indomitable spirit that we save every single grain across our national food baskets: no food goes to waste.

sections.label: SFA creation under MEWR
sections.summary: Says creating the SFA under MEWR is the right move and will enhance keeping food supply safe.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The creation of SFA under MEWR is the right move and will enhance our ability to keep our food supply safe.

sections.label: Trust in Singapore food brand
sections.summary: Notes widespread trust in developing Asia and the Middle East in the Singapore brand regarding food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: At the same time, there is also widespread trust in developing Asia and the Middle East in the Singapore brand with regard to food.

sections.label: Jilin-Singapore Food Industry Park
sections.summary: States that China's Jilin province is collaborating with Singapore through the Jilin-Singapore Food Industry Park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: A little-known fact is that China's Jilin province is collaborating with Singapore through the Jilin-Singapore Food Industry Park.

sections.label: Approved by Singapore mark
sections.summary: Hopes the Approved by Singapore mark can carry FDA-like clout and create revenue through SFA certification services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Hopefully, over time, our "Approved by Singapore" mark can carry as much clout as the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) with regard to drugs, and doing so can also create revenue opportunities for the Singapore Government, as SFA can offer certification services either out of Singapore or onsite in markets like China and India.

sections.label: Food imports statistics
sections.summary: AVA statistics show Singapore imports over 90% of the food consumed in the country.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: According to statistics from AVA, we import over 90% of the food consumed in our country.

sections.label: Global Food Security Index ranking
sections.summary: Singapore claimed the top spot in the 2018 Global Food Security Index despite relying on food imports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Despite our reliance on food imports, Singapore has managed to claim the top spot in the 2018 Global Food Security Index.

sections.label: Quality and Safety ranking
sections.summary: On the Index's Quality and Safety matrix, Singapore is ranked 24th.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: If we look at the Index’s other key matrix on Quality and Safety, we are ranked 24th.

sections.label: Food waste disposed 2017
sections.summary: In 2017 alone, more than 676,000 tonnes of food waste were disposed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: In 2017 alone, more than 676,000 tonnes of food waste were disposed.

sections.label: Food security no longer given
sections.summary: Climate change and human mismanagement disrupt food sources, so food security is no longer a given.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: As a regional and global port, our people have been fortunate in being able to obtain a great variety of food from different regions, even though we ourselves produce too little food for our own consumption.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: However, today, with climate change, as pointed out, and human mismanagement disrupting food sources, food security is no longer a given.

sections.label: Reducing meat and dairy consumption
sections.summary: The speaker urges the newly formed SFA to consider policies to reduce meat consumption.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Although Singapore is a small country, we can do our part by reducing our consumption of meat and dairy products, which also happens to be beneficial to our health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I urge the newly formed SFA to consider implementing policies to reduce meat consumption.

sections.label: Food safety efforts and SFA support
sections.summary: Asks what food safety efforts have been made and how the centralised SFA will operate differently, noting SFA needs support from several ministries and agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the Minister share with us what efforts have been made to ensure food safety so far and how the centralised SFA will operate differently to enhance our capability in ensuring food safety and quality?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: SFA will need the support of the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), the Ministry of Transport and other Government agencies to fulfill its mission to ensure food security.

sections.label: Import substitutes after neighbour curbs
sections.summary: Asks whether Singapore can import substitutes of comparable quality and safety after neighbours announced curbs on sales of certain food products.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Our neighbours have recently announced that sales of certain food products to Singapore will be curtailed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Will we be able to import substitutes of comparable quality and safety?

sections.label: Securing food supply overseas
sections.summary: States that to truly secure food supply, Singapore must venture overseas and secure it at the source.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: To truly secure our food supply, we must venture overseas and secure it at the source.

sections.label: SFA roles in emergencies
sections.summary: Asks what roles the SFA will play in an emergency situation, while noting prevention and preparedness to respond are both necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: It is important to prevent such incidents, but it is also necessary as well to be prepared to respond to these situations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: So, I would like to ask the Minister: what roles will the SFA play in an emergency situation, such as this?

sections.label: SARS and SFA setup
sections.summary: Recalls the February 2003 SARS outbreak and says setting up SFA will better cover procurement, production, hygiene and consumer information.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In fact, in February 2003, when the severe acute respiratory syndrome broke out in Singapore, it could have resulted in some serious consequences if we were unable to take swift action to get things under control.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Hence, the setting up of SFA will make us better placed to look into various aspects of our food supply, from its procurement, production and hygiene to the provision of accurate information for consumers.

sections.label: Food scientists and forfeiture penalties
sections.summary: Asks how many food scientists there are and whether experts will expand, and notes courts may direct forfeiture of property in accreditation offence cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: So, there are many changes in the management of additives and other food-related matters in the food chain, and I foresee our new food agency would have a very busy schedule ahead.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I would also like to ask the Minister how many food scientists do we have and whether we would be expanding our team of experts to cope with the role of the new food agency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Next, under the penalties for a person who is found falsifying or using without lawful authority any accreditation, certification or inspection mark, a Court trying the offenders has the power to direct that any property in respect of which the offence has been committed can be forfeited.

sections.label: Hygiene checks at eateries
sections.summary: The passage asks how often audits or checks are made at eateries and restaurants to ensure high hygiene standards for public health and safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Lastly, for the protection of public health and safety, how often are audits or checks made at the various eateries, restaurants and the like to ensure that all steps have been taken to ensure that a high hygiene standard is maintained?

sections.label: AVA expanded import sources
sections.summary: AVA expanded Singapore's import sources from 140 countries in 2004 to around 180 countries today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: AVA has already expanded our import sources from 140 countries in 2004 to around 180 countries today.

sections.label: SFA importer supply disruption plans
sections.summary: SFA will introduce requirements for importers of key food items to adopt plans to mitigate supply disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: SFA will introduce requirements for importers of key food items to adopt plans to mitigate any supply disruptions.

sections.label: Controlled environment agriculture expansion
sections.summary: Going forward, Singapore expects to expand into controlled environment agriculture in indoor vertical farming and deep-sea fish farming in its waters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Going forward, we expect to expand further into controlled environment agriculture in indoor vertical farming and deep-sea fish farming in our waters.

sections.label: Overseas Singapore food companies
sections.summary: Overseas-based Singapore companies can overcome land and manpower constraints, access bigger markets, lower costs through economies of scale, and reduce export prices to Singapore, citing Barramundi Asia's Brunei farm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: These overseas-based Singapore companies will be able to overcome land constraints and even manpower constraints, and access new and bigger overseas markets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This allows them to bring down costs through economies of scale and reduce the price of exports to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Barramundi Asia, which aspires to produce the fish equivalent of Kobe beef, has expanded to Brunei, where they are developing a 6,600-hectare fish farm to export an estimated 40,000 tonnes of fish back to Singapore.

sections.label: SFA integrates food safety operations
sections.summary: The formation of SFA will integrate food safety operations currently across AVA, NEA and HSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, the formation of SFA will integrate operations related to food safety which currently resides across AVA, NEA and HSA.

sections.label: NEA food outlet inspections
sections.summary: Over five years, NEA conducted more than 600,000 unannounced inspections of food retail outlets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In fact, over the last five years, NEA has conducted more than 600,000 unannounced inspections of food retail outlets.

sections.label: SFA licensing harmonisation role
sections.summary: SFA will look into harmonising licensing standards and combining existing licences for food businesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In addition to the emphasis on food safety, SFA will, as part of its functions, look into harmonising licensing standards and combining existing licences for food businesses.

sections.label: NCFS transfer to SFA
sections.summary: NCFS will transfer to SFA, bringing together over 100 food scientists and consolidating food diagnostics and safety research.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The NCFS, which Prof Fatimah Lateef alluded to, will be transferred to SFA under the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NCFS will bring together more than 100 food scientists from AVA, NEA and HSA, and consolidate key competencies in food diagnostics and research on food safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Consolidation will also eliminate the need for food samples to be tested in multiple laboratories across different agencies with different competencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This streamlining of processes as well as the sharing of facilities and technology will allow for greater operational, testing and cost efficiencies to be achieved.
